thread:
Ella (product): quick ask — need short takes on the compact version-history draft. specifically: the primary CTA next to each entry (pause vs rollback), SR announce behavior, and whether we should inline a snapshot step. figma: https://figma.redwood/abc123 Samir (design): skimming — main concern: people confuse 'pause' with 'revert'. pause should stop traffic but not change active version. wording needs to make that explicit in microcopy and tooltip. Maya (frontend): agreed. also thinking about keyboard affordances: single-key shortcuts could help power users but conflict risk. propose: 'P' = pause/resume, 'Shift+R' = rollback confirm flow. Jon (eng-runtime): heads up — rollback is an operation that triggers state machine + DB write and can be async. we need clear UX that rollback is not instant and provide status (in-progress, completed, failed). automatic fallback to previous variant is possible but must be opt-in. Priya (a11y): important: screen-reader announcements. For non-destructive actions (pause/resume) use aria-live="polite". For destructive/irreversible actions (rollback) use aria-live="assertive" and a focused alert dialog with role=alertdialog and descriptive text including the version id. Example copy: 'Rollback to v1.12 initiated. This will revert traffic and may take up to 2 minutes.' Ella (product): copy options to vote on: - Option A: primary button = "Pause rollout"; secondary = "Snapshot"; overflow = "Rollback (revert)" - Option B: primary = "Pause & Snapshot"; secondary = "Resume"; inline rollback = danger CTA with full label e.g. "Rollback to v1.12 — Revert changes" - Option C: single CTA: "Pause / Revert" (not great) Samir (design): my +1 is Option A. keep primary lightweight. promote snapshot as explicit step so users don't confuse pause with revert. maybe add subtle pill text under the entry: "paused — snapshot saved". Maya (frontend): implementation notes: prefer inline confirm (small confirm popover) for rollback instead of modal to keep context. also add an ephemeral undo toast: 'Rollback complete — Undo' for 10s. that covers most accidental clicks. Priya (a11y): inline confirm popover must be keyboard-focusable and trap focus while open. ensure the undo toast is reachable by SR and announces with role=status. sample markup: ```
Rollout paused at 55%
Rollback to v1.12 initiated — reverting traffic
``` Jon (eng-runtime): for the backend we can emit an operation-id and surface it in the toast: 'Rollback started (op #op-3345)'. that helps support. also recommend a confirmation checkbox when the change affects >50% traffic. Samir (design): microcopy tweak: tooltip for Pause: "Stops routing new traffic to this version. To undo, Resume." tooltip for Rollback: "Reverts active version to previous snapshot; this will change live traffic." keep verbs consistent (Stops / Reverts). Ella (product): what about the visual affordance in the compact timeline? we currently use a small orange pill for paused, red for rollback-in-progress. maybe add a thin heatline to indicate delta in traffic. thoughts? Maya (frontend): heatline is fine but needs accessible color semantics (contrast + icon fallback). add an explicit textual status next to the pill for narrow widths. Priya (a11y): color only is insufficient. include an icon with aria-hidden=true and textual label visually-hidden but in DOM for SR. e.g. `Paused — snapshot saved`. Ella (product): quick poll — respond with :+1: for Option A, :heart: for Option B, :thinking_face: for other ideas. Samir (design): :+1: Maya (frontend): :+1: Jon (eng-runtime): :heart: (lean B if we must reduce clicks for enterprise) Priya (a11y): :+1: (Option A with strong SR copy) DeployBot: Snapshot created for canary v1.12 -> prod: snap-20231101-3345 Ella (product): action items: 1) Samir update microcopy + tooltip 2) Maya wire inline confirm + undo toast 3) Jon attach op-id to toasts + recommend threshold checkbox 4) Priya add aria-live and hidden SR text. I'll drop a follow-up mock by EOD. Thanks all for quick takes.
